title: Reduce Safety Margin
statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to get closer to obstacles, potentially increasing the speed and efficiency of the path to the goal, but at the risk of collisions.
contradicting_evidence: Experiment plan_92aa076c: Observed delta=+0.000. Verdict: inconclusive (No statistically significant difference in collision count or success rate.). (Did not produce statistically distinguishable change)
